description.value: Ocean Crest Motel is a family-owned, year-round motel on Qualicum Beach's West Island Highway, situated directly across from the beach on central Vancouver Island. It has 19 rooms ranging from standard doubles to deluxe kitchenette units equipped for self-catering. The location puts cyclists within easy reach of Qualicum Beach's waterfront and nearby restaurants.

address.value: 3292 West Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, B.C. V9K 2C6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and covers rooms, policies, and amenities in detail. Phone (+1-250-752-5518), address (3292 West Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, B.C. V9K 2C6), and website all match OSM tags exactly. No mention of bicycle storage, bike handling, or cyclist-specific services anywhere on the site; Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed ('complimentary wifi' repeated across all pages); nearby dining is confirmed by 'exceptional restaurants just steps away' and 'Local Restaurants Menu' listed as an office amenity.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, year-round motel on a Vancouver Island touring route with a functioning website and confirmed contact details. Useful overnight stop for touring cyclists.
